name: hello-dsh
author: DSH Developer contributors
description: A tiny native DSH plugin that teaches a repeatable greeting workflow.
goal: Help a user create a concise greeting that matches the named audience and requested tone.
instructions: Ask for an audience and tone when either is missing. Produce one greeting, keep it under forty words, and do not invent personal facts.
decisions: Use one canonical Agent Skill for DSH and Codex.
unresolvedRisks: Different DSH surfaces may render skill invocation hints differently.
